notes.title: Playtesting has begun.
notes.notes: [p]Hello! This is Exovator, the developer of \[[b][i][u]Pierce The Wind[/u][/i][/b]].[/p][p][/p][p]I've released a playtest to help the game develop. The playtest version contains many unpolished elements and features that haven't been implemented yet.[/p][p][/p][p]Anyone interested in participating in the playtest is welcome to do so. It would be greatly appreciated if you could give it a try and leave some brief feedback.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for your continued interest. I will continue to strive to create an even better game.[/p]
